metadata.case_name: LEUNG CHI YAN v. CHAN TAI MAN AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: fractured distal shaft of the right femur
source: X-ray showed fracture shaft of right femur.
the Plaintiff suffered a fractured distal shaft of the right femur.
there was abrasion over his head

manifestations.description: right thigh swollen and tender on palpation
on and off pain that requires medical treatment on a need to basis
difficulty in long period of walking and manual exertion
depressed mood, poor sleep, fearfulness, pessimistic thinking
mixed anxiety and depressive disorder (psychiatric diagnosis)

treatments_received.treatment: Closed reduction and fixation with intra-medullary nail
source: Closed reduction and fixation with intra-medullary nail was performed to the Plaintiff on the same day.
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Closed reduction for fracture of arm / leg / patella / pelvis with internal fixation

treatments_received.treatment: Revision of the fixation with intra-medullary nail on 13 December 2007
source: Post-operative X-ray showed mal-position of the distal locking bolt, thus, revision of the fixation with intra-medullary nail has to perform on 13 December 2007 to re-fix the position.
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Open reduction for femur / calcaneus / talus / +/- internal fixation

treatments_received.treatment: Physiotherapy (2 treatment sessions: Hot Pad Therapy, ambulatory training, lower limbs mobilizing and strengthening exercised)
source: He had 2 physiotherapy treatment sessions and the treatments given included Hot Pad Therapy, ambulatory training, lower limbs mobilizing and strengthening exercised.

treatments_received.treatment: Psychiatric treatment at West Kowloon Psychiatric Centre
source: The Plaintiff developed depressed mood, poor sleep, fearfulness, pessimistic thinking and he feels that he had a great loss after the accident, therefore, he was referred to attend treatment at West Kowloon Psychiatric Centre.
The Plaintiff was diagnosed of mixed anxiety and depressive disorder. His last followed up session was at 4 June 2010.

losses.description: on and off pain that requires medical treatment on a need to basis
difficulty in long period of walking and manual exertion

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: minimal permanent adverse effect on his activities of daily living
depressed mood, poor sleep, fearfulness, pessimistic thinking; diagnosed mixed anxiety and depressive disorder
